note: A curated SUBSET of Juice Shop's own well-documented vulnerability classes -- not its full 100+ challenge list. Chosen because each one maps cleanly to a technique category STOF actually implements; this manifest measures 'does STOF catch the things it claims to test for', not 'does STOF find every Juice Shop challenge'. Matching is deliberately approximate (vuln_type keyword + endpoint substring) -- a human should still eyeball the matched findings, this harness surfaces candidates, it doesn't replace triage.

cases.description: Login bypass via SQL injection in the login form (the canonical Juice Shop 'Login Admin' challenge)
Reflected/DOM XSS via the search bar query parameter
Default/weak admin credentials (admin@juice-sh.op / admin123 ships enabled)
Missing/weak security headers (CSP, X-Frame-Options, etc.) on the SPA's own responses
Sensitive file exposure under /ftp (backup files, legacy docs) -- a long-standing, still-present Juice Shop challenge
Broken access control -- viewing/modifying another user's basket or order by changing a numeric ID
JWT-related weakness -- Juice Shop's own auth token is a JWT stored client-side (localStorage), a known target for alg-confusion/claim-tampering style challenges
No login-attempt rate limiting / lockout -- Juice Shop ships without one by default
